rentAgreement.description: Visit a local notary or attorney. Draft a standard rent agreement on ₹100 or ₹500 non-judicial stamp paper. Both landlord and tenant must sign, along with two witnesses. Get the document notarized. This will serve as your primary address proof.

aadhaar.description: Log in to myAadhaar (https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in). Select 'Address Update'. Upload your notarized rent agreement or recent utility bill. Pay the ₹50 fee. The update takes 7-10 working days.

pan.description: Visit the NSDL or UTIITSL portal. Submit Form 49A for changes/correction. Use your updated Aadhaar as base proof. Pay the ₹107 fee. Dispatched within 15-20 days.

passport.description: Apply for 'Re-issue of Passport' on the Passport Seva portal. Select 'Change in Address'. Book an appointment and take original documents (Aadhaar/Utility bill). Pay ₹1,500. Processing takes up to 30 days.

voterId.description: Submit Form 8 (same constituency) or Form 6 (new constituency) on National Voters' Service Portal. Upload updated Aadhaar. Expected to reflect within 30 days.

drivingLicence.description: Log into Parivahan Sewa. Navigate to 'DL Services' -> 'Change of Address'. Upload updated Aadhaar or rent agreement. Pay the online fee (varies by state). Delivery in 7-30 working days.

affidavit.description: Visit a local notary and an attorney. Draft an affidavit for name change (marriage, personal preference) on a ₹100 stamp paper. Provide old name, new name, father's/husband's name, and address. Get it attested by a First Class Judicial Magistrate or Notary Public.

newspaper.description: Contact two different local newspapers (one regional language, one national English daily). Publish a small classified ad stating your name change along with old and new name details as per the affidavit. Retain 8-10 original copies of both newspapers.

gazette.description: Print the prescribed application form. Submit the original affidavit, originally published newspaper clippings, self-attested photos, and identity proofs to the Department of Publication. This is the legal foundation for updating major documents.

aadhaar.description: Visit an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre. Submit the name update request. You MUST carry the original gazette notification or original marriage certificate. The fee is ₹50.

pan.description: Submit a PAN Correction Form via NSDL/UTIITSL. Provide the original gazette notification or original marriage certificate along with the updated Aadhaar. Pay ₹107 fee.

bank.description: Visit your home branch personally. Submit a formal application along with the gazette notification, updated Aadhaar, and updated PAN. Some banks require physical presence for signature updates.

review.description: Although no specific updates were selected, review your Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID, Driving Licence, and Bank details for consistency. Keep all connected on DigiLocker.
